# YYYY-MM-DD: concrete outcome

## Request and scope
Record the authorized outcome, workstream and source revision/identifiers. Note unrelated work that remains paused only when relevant.

## Starting evidence
Link the prior status/case and actual artifacts inspected. Distinguish inherited claims from fresh checks.

## Investigation and decisions
For each meaningful attempt: observed symptom, action, result, evidence, and whether the cause/fix is proven. Preserve useful failures without copying secrets or raw conversations.

## Delivered result and verification
List changed files/artifacts, actual commands and exact relevant results. Separate data, native-open, visual and business acceptance.

## Open work and next entry point
Record unresolved limitations and the next concrete action. Link lessons, ADRs and runbooks updated. State whether the task is complete, partial or waiting for a specific external input.
